title: Agent Comparison Record v0.1
description: Turn P3: one record per (benchmark_run_id, agent_variant_id, dataset_item_id) execution inside a four-variant comparison run. Deliberately does NOT store raw answer text, raw ExecutionTrace, raw prompt, raw model response, an API key, or an internal exception message -- only content hashes (answer_sha256, execution_trace_sha256) and the already-aggregated counts/flags TelemetryEvent (domain/agent-comparison/interfaces/telemetry-event.schema.json) provides. This is a wiring/reproducibility artifact, never a Gold record and never a quality score -- a scorer reading this must exclude any row with scoring_eligible=false from a model-quality comparison. latency_ms is the one intentionally-observational field: it is excluded from execution_trace_sha256's hashed input (see determinism.mjs), so two runs over identical input produce the same execution_trace_sha256 even though real latency differs.

agent_variant_revision.description: git blob hash of the variant's own primary flow file at the ref this run used (domain/agent-comparison/integration/variant-revisions.mjs), or "unknown" if it could not be determined.

release_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the approved v0.20-r3 bundle-manifest.json bytes (domain/agent-comparison/integration/release-pin.mjs) -- pins which bundle every variant in this comparison run actually read.

model_failure_code.description: One of contracts.mjs's MODEL_CALL_ERROR_CODES when the failure happened inside a ModelAdapter call, or a harness-level code (e.g. AGENT_VARIANT_EXECUTION_ERROR) when run_status="FAILED" because the comparison harness itself could not obtain a FinalResponse for this variant at all (unregistered variant, factory construction threw, etc.) -- never a raw exception message.

scoring_eligible.description: false whenever model_fallback_used is true OR run_status is FAILED. A comparison/scoring pass MUST exclude any row where this is false.

latency_ms.description: OBSERVATIONAL ONLY. Real wall-clock duration of this variant's run. Excluded from execution_trace_sha256's hashed input -- never use this field to check run-to-run determinism.

answer_sha256.description: sha256 of final_response.answer's exact text. null only when run_status="FAILED" and no answer was ever produced.

execution_trace_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonicalized ExecutionTrace with all volatile timing fields stripped (determinism.mjs). null only when run_status="FAILED".

run_status.description: OK: the harness obtained a FinalResponse/ExecutionTrace for this variant (this says nothing about whether the ANSWER itself was grounded -- see citation_binding_status/scoring_eligible for that). FAILED: the harness itself could not run this variant at all (e.g. unregistered variant_id, or the variant's factory/constructor threw before runAgentFlow could even be invoked) -- every other count field is 0/null/false in that case, not a guess.
